model: gen1 return-shape fingerprint: LDA on standardised shape features; score = ((x - mean) / std) @ coef + intercept  (equivalently x @ coef_raw + intercept_raw); p = 1 / (1 + exp(-score))
fitted_from: analysis/rcg/fingerprint_fit.py, reproducing analysis/rcg/return_shape.py gen1 pass B (NE patch excluded)

label.defn: p(NE-like) from Landsat-5 2008-10-29 two-class ML (map_ne_like.py), nearest 30 m pixel at the 5 m cell centre; in class at p > 0.5
label.caveat: an imagery spectral class, not a species map

training_domain.defn: flat & open5 & ~NE, then >= 30 pooled returns, >= 1 own in-range return (REQUIRE_OWN_RETURN), finite features, finite logit(p)
training_domain.open5: gen2 full-density cloud has no return above 2 m in the cell (rcg/gen2_cellstats.npz above2m == 0)
training_domain.NE: largest 8-connected patch of dod_floodplain_vegcorr < -lod on the floodplain, EXCLUDED

histogram.pooling: 3x3 cells, scipy uniform_filter mode=nearest, x9, rint

feature_defs.lo_w: p50 - p10 of the pooled gen1 return heights, mm (lower width)
feature_defs.bowley: (p75 + p25 - 2 p50) / max(p75 - p25, 20 mm) (Bowley skew, dimensionless)
feature_defs.peak: share of pooled returns within +/-50 mm of the mode
feature_defs.tail_L: mean of (h - mode - 100 mm) over returns above mode + 100 mm (e-folding length of the upper tail), mm
feature_defs.tail_mass: share of pooled returns above mode + 100 mm
feature_defs.low_mass: share of pooled returns below mode - 100 mm

on_record: RCG_PHENOLOGY.md section S: shape-only AUC 0.71 (patch excluded), 0.82 (patch included)
